summary: Ji-yong Kim worked in Buddhist studies and philosophy. Publications from 1976 attest him as a professor at both Shitennoji University and Shitennoji Junior College.

Jiang Wu works in Buddhist studies and sinology. He pursued graduate studies at Nankai University and earned his doctorate at Harvard under Tu Weiming and Robert M. Gimello. He was attested as a professor at the University of Arizona (2011–2018).
Jianming Hu specializes in Buddhist studies. In 2015, Hu was attested as studying at Waseda University and holding a researcher post at Komazawa University.

Jien Abe (1937–2001) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied as a graduate student at the University of Tokyo (attested 1973) and served as a professor at Meiji University until 2001.
Jigmeth Junu is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MA at Fo Guang University (attested 2013) under supervisor Yongdong Shi, having also studied under traditional teacher Hui Xian.
Jikai Fujiyoshi (1915–1996) specialized in Buddhist studies. He served as a professor at Rissho University and was attested as a member at Kyoto University in 1967.

Jikido Takasaki (1926–2013) worked in Buddhist studies and Indology. He earned PhDs from Savitribai Phule Pune University and the University of Tokyo, later serving as professor at Tokyo (1977–1987) and president of Tsurumi University (1992–2004).
Jim G. Shaffer (born 1944) is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at Arizona State University (~1964–1968) and the University of Wisconsin-Madison (~1968–1972).

Jim Rheingans specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He completed an MA at the University of Hamburg and a PhD through the University of the West of England and Bath Spa University, supervised by David P. Jackson, Mahinda Deegalle, and Fiona Montgomery.

Jim Taylor works in religious studies and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at Macquarie University by 1989 and was attested as Senior Lecturer in Anthropology at the University of Adelaide in 2014.

Jin Y. Park works in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. Park held an appointment as Assistant Professor of Philosophy and Religion at American University (attested 2007–2012) and served as a visiting fellow at City University of Hong Kong.

Jinah Kim specializes in history, archaeology, Indology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at UC Berkeley under Joanna Gottfried Williams. Kim held posts at Harvard University, Vanderbilt University, and a fellowship at the Institute for Advanced Study (2009–2010).

Jinbo Shi (born 1940) specializes in sinology, linguistics, and Tibetology. He studied at Minzu University of China (~1958–1962) and held posts at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and its Institute of Ethnology and Anthropology (~1966/1977–2010).
Jinchuan Wan works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. In 2010, Wan was attested as holding professorships at both National Central University and Fo Guang University.
Jing Yin specializes in Buddhist studies. Having studied under K. L. Dhammajoti (attested 1995), Yin served as Director at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2006–2010).

Jing-shen Tao (born 1933) is a historian and sinologist. He studied at National Taiwan University (~1952–1959) and Indiana University (~1964–1967), later serving as Professor of East Asian Studies at the University of Arizona (~1976–2000).
Jingkong (1927–2022) was a Buddhist studies figure who studied under Thomé H. Fang (~1953–1958) and Bingnan Li (~1958–1968).

Jinhua Chen works in Buddhist studies and sinology. He completed graduate studies at McMaster University and postdoctoral research at Kyoto University. Chen held posts at the University of Virginia (attested 2001) and the University of British Columbia (attested 2008–2018).

Jinhua Jia specializes in sinology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Colorado Boulder under Paul W. Kroll, later holding posts at Harvard, City University of Hong Kong, and Hong Kong Polytechnic University.
Jinling He works in the field of Buddhist studies and earned a Master of Arts degree at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Koki Okumura.
